misclassification_review.path_spelling_risk: none: no space, no CJK, no leading dash; argv-form subprocess avoids shell quoting; argparse parses cleanly
misclassification_review.detail: during the changed probe the counter's worktree file already contains the forged content, so a tool that compares the working tree instead of the candidate commit object still emits DRIFT/exit 1 for this cell; this cell alone cannot detect worktree-vs-commit confusion
misclassification_review.token_check: counter checks token in stdout+stderr combined and requires exact exit equality; a token-only or exit-only match fails closed
misclassification_review.tool_absent_at_freeze: counter would report passed=0/24 reason=tool-absent; not a per-cell misclassification but blocks certification without --tool
misclassification_review.determinism: blob ids content-addressed and reproducible across replicas; commit ids timestamp-dependent and differ per replica, which is fine since counter uses its own commits
